notes: The author calls it a story game with choices and that is what it is — an authored school drama delivered in fixed scenes — so Adventure leads. I did not name Roleplay & Avatar Sim second even though the setting is school life, because that genre is open-ended social storytelling built around a housing model, and naming it here would drag a claimable-house town into a five-room story; nothing in its options table survives that the shape does not already give. Shape is rooms-sequence, taken from the wider catalogue rather than Adventure's typical outdoor list, because the author asked for only the rooms the story visits joined by hallways — classroom, hallway, cafeteria, teacher's office and the courtyard — and it routes P0. No Adventure preset survives contact: Story's chapter maps, cinematic reveal and one-way drops are all contradicted by one school map revisited day after day with every ending in the same courtyard, so this is built from scratch with the cast as npc-population and the scene-by-scene advance as gate-progression. Deciding without a user: I kept this at P0 rather than adding building-interior, since the interiors are the map itself and the courtyard is an open-topped node in the same sequence, not a building entered from a street; the uniform detail is avatar cosmetics and out of layout scope.
